decision: Relative-strength reversal in bear markets is exploratory; insufficient PRE sample, strict cross-sectional coverage and matched control issues. No production change.

protocol.snapshot: Every UTC 0/6/12/18, >=8 QA eligible assets, preceding 168 completed H1 returns. OLS beta of alt on BTC, clipped [0,3], residual log returns alt-beta*BTC (no intercept removal), standardized by trailing residual hourly std times sqrt horizon. Score uses only confirmed bars.
protocol.regimes: BEAR BTC trailing24 and72h returns negative and >=60% of QA peers trailing24h down; BULL symmetric; otherwise MIXED.

arms.BEAR_RESID_MOM: BEAR, SHORT weakest normalized residual24h, score <=-0.5
arms.BEAR_RESID_REV: BEAR, SHORT strongest normalized residual24h, score >=0.5
arms.BEAR_RAW_MOM: BEAR, SHORT weakest raw24h, return negative
arms.BEAR_DIVERGENCE: BEAR, SHORT strongest residual6h minus residual72h, residual72h negative, score difference>=0.5
arms.MIXED_RESID_REV: MIXED, compare absolute top/bottom residual24h, take opposite direction of larger extreme >=1.5

protocol.exit: 12/24/48h fixed exits, hard STOP8 symmetric, adverse gap, actual M5 open, 0.30 gross per position, original 2-slot wallet 12h cooldown, 10/30bps. Candidate ranking independent of future path availability. Only priced results; unresolved count.
protocol.decomposition: At each snapshot and horizon measure market return beta component, residual log return, extreme quintile (2 or more), market regime and signed absolute price return. Diagnostic no STOP for horizon returns. Compare strongest/weakest residual cohorts same time.
protocol.controls: 32 seeded same-snapshot alternative-symbol controls on every arm with >=2 profitable periods or BOTH_MOM/BOTH_REV at 24h; same direction and same quality cohort, >=2 available alternatives, same wallet. Historical periods already inspected; thresholds frozen before results. No funding; no production.
